set(fixture_root "${PROJECT_BINARY_DIR}/tests/runtime/$<CONFIG>")
dfy_add_plugin(dfy_test_probe probe.cpp probe.json.in OUTPUT_ROOT "${fixture_root}")
dfy_add_plugin(dfy_fixture_model_scripted model/plugin.cpp model/manifest.json.in OUTPUT_ROOT "${fixture_root}")
dfy_add_plugin(dfy_fixture_channel_simulator channel/plugin.cpp channel/manifest.json.in OUTPUT_ROOT "${fixture_root}")
file(READ "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/channel/dual.json.in" dual_channel_manifest)
string(REPLACE "@LIBRARY@" "$<TARGET_FILE_NAME:dfy_fixture_channel_simulator>" dual_channel_manifest "${dual_channel_manifest}")
file(GENERATE OUTPUT "${fixture_root}/plugins/dfy_fixture_channel_dual.json" CONTENT "${dual_channel_manifest}")
dfy_add_plugin(dfy_fixture_memory_minimal memory/plugin.cpp memory/manifest.json.in OUTPUT_ROOT "${fixture_root}")
dfy_add_plugin(dfy_fixture_search_primary service_providers/primary.cpp service_providers/primary.json.in OUTPUT_ROOT "${fixture_root}")
dfy_add_plugin(dfy_fixture_search_secondary service_providers/secondary.cpp service_providers/secondary.json.in OUTPUT_ROOT "${fixture_root}")
dfy_add_plugin(dfy_fixture_action_search service_consumer/plugin.cpp service_consumer/manifest.json.in OUTPUT_ROOT "${fixture_root}")
dfy_add_plugin(dfy_fixture_action_remember memory_commit/plugin.cpp memory_commit/manifest.json.in OUTPUT_ROOT "${fixture_root}")
dfy_add_plugin(dfy_fixture_action_background job/plugin.cpp job/manifest.json.in OUTPUT_ROOT "${fixture_root}")
dfy_add_plugin(dfy_fixture_action_write_demo unknown_effect/plugin.cpp unknown_effect/manifest.json.in OUTPUT_ROOT "${fixture_root}")
dfy_add_plugin(dfy_fixture_activity_reflection wakeup/plugin.cpp wakeup/manifest.json.in OUTPUT_ROOT "${fixture_root}")
dfy_add_plugin(dfy_fixture_context_clock context_subscription/plugin.cpp context_subscription/manifest.json.in OUTPUT_ROOT "${fixture_root}")
dfy_add_plugin(dfy_fixture_action_behavior command/plugin.cpp command/manifest.json.in OUTPUT_ROOT "${fixture_root}")
dfy_add_plugin(dfy_fixture_scopes scopes/plugin.cpp scopes/manifest.json.in OUTPUT_ROOT "${fixture_root}")
set(tree_node 0)
foreach(role IN ITEMS root relay leaf)
  math(EXPR tree_node "${tree_node}+1")
  dfy_add_plugin(dfy_fixture_tree_${role} call_tree/probe.cpp call_tree/${role}.json.in OUTPUT_ROOT "${fixture_root}")
  target_compile_definitions(dfy_fixture_tree_${role} PRIVATE DFY_TREE_NODE=${tree_node})
endforeach()
add_custom_target(dfy_test_fixtures)
get_property(fixture_targets DIRECTORY PROPERTY BUILDSYSTEM_TARGETS)
foreach(target IN LISTS fixture_targets)
  if(NOT target STREQUAL dfy_test_fixtures)
    add_dependencies(dfy_test_fixtures ${target})
  endif()
endforeach()
